# Benefit Builder LLC

> Texas-based Section 125 cafeteria plan administrator. We help employers offer stronger pre-tax benefits to their teams and stay IRS-compliant, with bundled plan documents, nondiscrimination testing, and payroll integration, all for one monthly fee.

Founded 2019, family-run, headquartered in Conroe, TX. Serves employers and brokers nationwide. All-inclusive monthly fee, no surprise costs. A Section 125 cafeteria plan lets employees pay for qualified benefits with pre-tax dollars; the lower payroll cost is a rolled-in result, not the product.

## What we do

- Section 125 cafeteria plan and Premium Only Plan (POP) administration
- Pre-tax benefit deductions through payroll
- Nondiscrimination testing (NDT)
- Plan documents, adoption agreements, salary reduction agreements
- Payroll integration and roster sync
- HSA and FSA administration
- Supplemental benefits: life, accident, critical illness, disability, gap
- Broker partnership program

## Industries we serve

Section 125 cafeteria plan administration tailored to how each industry hires, pays, and works.

- [Manufacturing](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/manufacturing): Pre-tax benefits for production teams and skilled labor
- [Senior Care](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/senior-care): Nursing homes, assisted living, hospice, home care
- [Trades and Contractors](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/trades-contractors): HVAC, electrical, roofing, plumbing
- [Schools and Education](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/schools-education): Faculty and support staff, school pay calendars
- [Healthcare](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/healthcare): Clinics, dental, physician practices, home care
- [Restaurants and Hospitality](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/restaurants-hospitality): Hourly and tipped staff, hotels, food service
- [Retail](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/retail): Stores, shops, grocers
- [Transportation and Logistics](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/transportation-logistics): Trucking, delivery, fleets
- [Agriculture](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/agriculture): Farms, ranches, ag businesses
- [Automotive](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/automotive): Dealerships, body shops, repair
- [Professional Services](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/professional-services): Accounting, legal, insurance, title, real estate
- [Nonprofits and Faith-Based](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/nonprofits): Churches, ministries, charities
- [Construction](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/construction): General contractors and builders
- [Property Management](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/industries/property-management): Apartment communities, real estate operators

## Service areas

Benefit Builder administers Section 125 plans across nine states, with detail specific to each state's income tax.

- [Service Areas](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations): Hub for all states and cities
- [Missouri](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/missouri): Flat 4.7% state income tax; cities include Cape Girardeau, Poplar Bluff, Festus
- [Texas](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/texas): No state income tax; home state; cities include Conroe, Houston, Baytown, Laredo
- [Oklahoma](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/oklahoma): Bracketed up to 4.75%; Durant
- [New Mexico](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/new-mexico): Bracketed 1.7% to 5.9%; Farmington and the Four Corners
- [Ohio](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/ohio): Flat 3.5%; Dayton
- [Michigan](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/michigan): Flat 4.05%; Southfield and the Detroit metro
- [Colorado](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/colorado): Flat 4.4%; Centennial and the Denver metro
- [Illinois](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/illinois): Flat 4.95%
- [Georgia](https://benefitbuilderllc.com/locations/georgia): Flat 5.39%
